caption: The drawing depicts a wooden articulated figure of a person, shown standing upright. The figure is predominantly dark brown in color, with different sections making up the movable parts at the shoulders, elbows, hips, and knees. The figure is wearing a light brown hat with a darker brown band around the crown. The facial features, including the eyes, nose, and mouth, are clearly outlined with black and white detailing, particularly in the eyes, which are also highlighted with yellow. Red accents can be seen in the form of buttons on the torso,  a belt-like stripe around the waist, and bands around the tops of the boots. The figure stands against a plain, off-white background, and there is a signature “S. SANDLER” in the bottom right corner.
title: Dancing Doll
